etsy.title: JavaScript Poster, .then().catch().finally() Promise Chain Print, Coding Wall Art, Frontend Developer Gift
etsy.description:
A minimalist JavaScript poster for the promise chain every developer knows: resolve, reject, clean up.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang for a home office, dev den, or coding setup.

This listing is a physical poster print. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: JavaScript posters on Etsy are mostly cheat sheets sold as digital downloads ($2 to $10); joke-led prints are fewer.
Humorous JS prints use code snippets as the joke (an if/else life loop, a JavaScript 'definition'), the same angle as this poster.
Several listings stack 'gift for programmer' and 'wall decor for office' in the title.
JavaScript humor on Amazon is overwhelmingly T-shirts and pillows; almost no JS wall art.
'Frontend engineer' and 'web developer' are the common audience words.

research.notes: Listing pages were not fetched (network allow-list); evidence is from Etsy/Amazon search results only. 'javascript poster' is an Etsy market phrase and the printed code is JavaScript promise syntax. No priceRange: JS results were digital downloads.
